name: Integer sum-product extremal sets
description: construct() -> n=20 distinct positive integers <=maximum=10000. Compute A+A and A*A with equal summands/factors allowed. Minimize max(|A+A|,|A*A|). Exactly 20 distinct positive integers at most 10000, minimizing the maximum of sumset and product-set sizes. This uses integers rather than arbitrary reals, and includes diagonal pairs.

state_of_the_art.statement: No documented minimum of max(|A+A|, |AA|) for 20-element integer sets. The Erdős-Szemerédi sum-product conjecture is Erdős Problem #52. Solymosi proved max(|A+A|, |AA|) >= |A|^(4/3)/(2 ceil(log |A|))^(1/3) for sets of real numbers.
